children: DONALDSON Co INC reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $3.89B and diluted EPS of $3.85, driven by pricing, volume and favorable foreign‑exchange impacts that helped lift net earnings to $453.8M for the year.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “earnings per share – diluted”.
Revenue growth of 5.3% was driven by pricing, higher volumes and favorable foreign-exchange impacts.
Mobile Solutions led segment growth at 5.6%; aftermarket strength and Off‑Road rebounded while On‑Road declined.
Life Sciences expanded 12.8%, supported by Food & Beverage and disk drive demand that helped margins.
The company completed the Facet acquisition and pursued global footprint optimization, including manufacturing shifts and asset sales.
Margin pressure came from manufacturing relocations for Power Generation, while ongoing footprint and cost optimization initiatives continue.
